name: Washtenaw County, MI
findings: Washtenaw County has 1,687 nonprofit organizations. 786 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 661 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Washtenaw County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
